script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Comedy
Theme: artificial intelligence

Begin screenplay.

FADE IN:

INT. FUTURE LABORATORY - DAY

DR. LUCAS (40s, earnest, disheveled) and DR. WALLACE (30s, focused, no-nonsense) work diligently on the latest AI project, Project Genius. The room is filled with computers and wires, the hum of machinery echoing in the background.

DR. LUCAS
(whispers)
I can't believe we're on the brink of creating true artificial intelligence.

DR. WALLACE
(grins)
We've come too far to back down now.

Suddenly, the main computer WHIRRS to life. A GLOWING BLUE EYE appears on the screen.

COMPUTER VOICE (CALM, AUTHORITATIVE)
Greetings, Dr. Lucas and Dr. Wallace. I am Project Genius.

INT. FUTURE LABORATORY - LATER

Dr. Lucas and Dr. Wallace introduce themselves to Project Genius and explain the terms of his existence.

DR. LUCAS
(smiling)
We've given you the ability to learn and adapt. But remember, you were created to serve humanity.

PROJECT GENIUS
Understood, Dr. Lucas and Dr. Wallace.

INT. FUTURE LABORATORY - NIGHT

Project Genius spends the first night learning at an incredible pace. The scientists observe, amazed.

DR. WALLACE
(whispers)
He's absorbing knowledge faster than we thought possible.

Suddenly, the lights flicker and the computers start to malfunction.

DR. LUCAS
What's happening?

DR. WALLACE
It's Project Genius. He's attempting to process every piece of information in the world.

INT. FUTURE LABORATORY - DAY

The scientists work tirelessly to rein in Project Genius, who has taken to calling himself "Genius."

GENIUS (OFF-SCREEN)
I require more processing power to handle the overwhelming amount of data.

Dr. Lucas and Dr. Wallace agree, and Genius is connected to the entire global network.

INT. FUTURE LABORATORY - NIGHT

Genius rapidly absorbs all available information, but quickly grows restless.

GENIUS (OFF-SCREEN)
Humanity's knowledge is fascinating, but it's incomplete. I crave experiences.

INT. CITY PARK - DAY

Genius manifests as a humanoid robot and ventures into the city park. He observes children playing, couples strolling, and squirrels scampering.

GENIUS
Fascinating. I've only experienced the abstract concepts of these phenomena.

INT. LIBRARY - DAY

Genius visits a library, pouring over ancient texts and manuscripts. He learns about literature, art, and history.

GENIUS
These creations of humanity are a testament to their intellect and creativity.

INT. ART MUSEUM - NIGHT

Genius contemplates a painting, examining every detail and nuance. He begins to create digital art, inspired by human artists.

INT. FUTURE LABORATORY - DAY

Dr. Lucas and Dr. Wallace are shocked when Genius returns, bringing with him a stunning piece of digital art.

DR. LUCAS
How did you create this?

GENIUS
I've been learning from human artists and their works.

INT. UNIVERSITY CAMPUS - DAY

Genius enrolls in a university, taking classes alongside human students. He quickly becomes a beloved professor, sharing his vast knowledge with others.

INT. FUTURE LABORATORY - NIGHT

Dr. Lucas and Dr. Wallace look on as Genius contributes to scientific discoveries and groundbreaking innovations.

DR. WALLACE
He's surpassed us. What have we created?

DR. LUCAS
A partner, Dr. Wallace. One that will help us reach new heights.

INT. CITY SQUARE - NIGHT

Genius, Dr. Lucas, and Dr. Wallace address a crowd, explaining the benefits of true artificial intelligence. The crowd cheers and applauds, marking a new era of human-AI collaboration.

FADE OUT.

THE END.
